I read through a batch of digital marketing job ads in Mauritius this year, and one thing stood out.

The titles look simple. The requirements do not.

One role asks for Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, analytics, content, design and reporting, often in both English and French. SEO listings now mention GEO, AEO and AI search. Agencies ask for a portfolio and real campaign examples, not just a certificate.

If you are a graduate or thinking about a career change, that can feel like a lot. But there is a clear pattern behind it: channels, tools, data and AI. Learn those layers in order and the job ads start to read like a checklist.

In my new article I break down the roles that exist locally, the tools employers name again and again, how to build a portfolio before your first job, and how AI is changing the work.

If you are job hunting or helping someone who is, this one is for you.
